other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a religious minority community as defined in the Government Order
No member of the applicant's family shall be an employee of the State/Central/Government PSU
Applicant and family members should not have availed of benefits under any other scheme (excluding the Arivu Scheme) of the KMDCL in the last 5 years
Annual family income must be less than ₹1,03,000 in urban areas and less than ₹81,000 in rural areas
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000, split equally between a loan and a subsidy.
